"""Migration of the Meridian CRM 4.2 DW export chunking loop."""


def export_chunks(rows: list[str], send) -> int:
    """Send formatted records in legacy-compatible 500-record newline chunks."""
    batch = ""
    n = 0
    total_sent = 0

    for rec in rows:
        batch = batch + rec + "\n"
        n += 1

        if n == 500:
            send(batch)
            total_sent += n
            batch = ""
            n = 0

    if n > 0:
        send(batch)
        total_sent += n

    return total_sent
